reviewed_contract: Unchanged production wcc_fused.representatives(frame,1,0), 3a controller source guarded clean
289 executable and original ffcf native package fingerprints checked before/after
BIGINT schema and exact row identity/count checked; no float conversion in fixture/oracle
Two live child worker processes with matching executable hashes recorded
Actual server explain and task_runner debug execution plans/status retained
Supervisor retains diagnostics/errors and enforces unique output namespace, CPU16-23/12GiB and deadline
No bootstrap, dataset copying, source mutation or cache deletion
limits: No remote calls, runtime execution or compilation in this independent review
Prepared result is not completed WCC, convergence/certificate, scale or performance evidence
Live child PIDs alone do not prove both workers ran the aggregate; inspect matching worker task status and execution plan logs after launch
Server explain is an observed plan the server would execute; successful collect and execution task logs are separate evidence
Isolated vertices absent from edge input are intentionally outside representatives active-vertex contract
Boundary witnesses are not exhaustive proof against all precision-loss implementations; exact result checks remain mandatory
Runtime hash provenance relies on earlier build receipt, not a fresh build by this audit
